title: Gapped sentences 1
instructions: For questions 1-6, think of ONE word only which can be used appropriately in all three sentences.

questions.prompt: The suspect will appear in court tomorrow to answer a _____ of armed robbery. / Most of the electric vans can be left to _____ overnight at the depot. / She took _____ of the investigation after the previous inspector retired.
questions.explanation: «Charge»: cargo/acusación («a charge of robbery»), cargar una batería (intransitivo) y «take charge of» (hacerse cargo de).

questions.prompt: The company is planning to build a desalination _____ on the coast. / Detectives suspected that someone had tried to _____ evidence in the victim's car. / Volunteers will _____ two thousand trees along the riverbank this spring.
questions.explanation: «Plant»: planta industrial, colocar pruebas falsas para incriminar («plant evidence») y plantar árboles.

questions.prompt: The union has threatened to _____ a complaint with the labour tribunal. / Officers keep a confidential _____ on every informant they handle. / The firefighters walked in single _____ through the narrow tunnel.
questions.explanation: «File»: presentar formalmente («file a complaint»), expediente o ficha, y «in single file» (en fila india).

questions.prompt: Rainfall last month broke the previous _____, which had stood since 1989. / A suspect with no criminal _____ is less likely to be remanded in custody. / All maintenance work must be kept on _____ for at least five years.
questions.explanation: «Record»: récord, antecedentes penales («criminal record») y «keep on record» (dejar constancia/registro).

questions.prompt: The judge handed down a _____ of six years' imprisonment. / Try to keep each _____ short when writing a technical report. / The court will _____ the two defendants next Monday.
questions.explanation: «Sentence»: condena, oración gramatical y el verbo «sentence» (dictar sentencia/condenar).

questions.prompt: Workers at the refinery have voted to go on _____ over pay. / Police believe the gang may _____ again before the end of the month. / It didn't _____ me as odd at the time that he was carrying two phones.
questions.explanation: «Strike»: huelga («go on strike»), atacar o actuar de nuevo («strike again») y «strike somebody as» (parecerle a alguien).

title: Gapped sentences 2
instructions: For questions 1-6, think of ONE word only which can be used appropriately in all three sentences.

questions.prompt: Police obtained a _____ to search the warehouse. / The test results hardly _____ such an expensive redesign of the turbine. / A European arrest _____ was issued for the fugitive.
questions.explanation: «Warrant»: orden judicial («search warrant», «arrest warrant») y el verbo «warrant» (justificar, merecer).

questions.prompt: The new exhibition is expected to _____ large crowds. / It is too early to _____ any firm conclusions from the data. / The match ended in a goalless _____.
questions.explanation: «Draw»: atraer público («draw crowds»), sacar conclusiones («draw conclusions») y empate («a goalless draw»).

questions.prompt: The engineers calculated how much weight the beam could _____. / Please _____ in mind that the site will be closed on Friday. / The documents found at the scene _____ the signature of a senior official.
questions.explanation: «Bear»: soportar carga, «bear in mind» (tener en cuenta) y llevar/presentar una firma o marca.

questions.prompt: The ministry is expected to _____ new safety guidelines next month. / Funding remains the most contentious _____ in the negotiations. / The latest _____ of the journal focuses on hydrogen storage.
questions.explanation: «Issue»: publicar o emitir (normas, documentos), cuestión o asunto polémico, y número de una revista.

questions.prompt: She has been asked to _____ the new laboratory when it opens. / The pipeline will _____ for 300 kilometres across the desert. / The suspect made a _____ for the exit when he saw the officers.
questions.explanation: «Run»: dirigir/gestionar, extenderse (un oleoducto, una carretera) y «make a run for» (echar a correr hacia).

questions.prompt: The suspect was taken into _____ shortly after midnight. / The parents are currently fighting for _____ of their two children. / Samples must remain in secure _____ until they reach the laboratory.
questions.explanation: «Custody»: detención («take into custody»), custodia de los hijos y custodia de pruebas (cadena de custodia).
